items.title: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to the Agentic AI Foundation
items.summary_en: Anthropic is giving its Agent Skills standard to the Agentic AI Foundation. The post says more than 70 agent platforms have adopted the standard.
items.notes: Read via newsroom index summary; full post text not reviewed.

items.title: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
items.summary_en: Anthropic invites life sciences researchers to apply for special collaborative projects with the company.
items.notes: Read via newsroom index summary; full post text not reviewed.

items.title: Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust
items.summary_en: Physicist and former Harvard science dean Christopher Stubbs has joined the Long-Term Benefit Trust. The post highlights his expertise in cosmology and precision measurement.

items.title: Anthropic to commit a portion of its shares to a Public Benefit Fund
items.summary_en: Anthropic says it will commit a portion of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund. The fund's stake is described as growing as the company grows.
items.notes: Share amount and governance details not verified.

items.title: Update on independent evaluators: METR gets employee-like access
items.summary_en: Anthropic gives METR employee-like access to evaluate its systems. The post says talks are underway with other organizations, such as Hugging Face.
items.notes: Relevant to METR; METR's own account of this arrangement not checked.

items.title: Preparing for the 2026 US midterms
items.summary_en: Anthropic outlines further strengthening of its election safeguards ahead of the 2026 US midterm elections.

items.title: Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs MOU with Singapore government
items.summary_en: Anthropic announces a Singapore office and a memorandum of understanding with the Singapore government on responsible AI adoption.

items.title: Strengthening defenses against distillation attacks
items.summary_en: Anthropic reports that new defenses cut illicit distillation of Claude's capabilities by more than 90%.
items.notes: The 90% figure is Anthropic's own claim; method not reviewed.
